checks.name: planted_edge
checks.description: seed 7; after every flagged close the exit open (day t+2) gets +1%. Average trade net of cost should sit ~0.9%: the planted 1% minus 0.1% of costs.

checks.name: pure_noise
checks.description: seed 8; same bars and flags, nothing planted. Average trade should be ~-0.1% (just the two 0.05% cost legs) plus noise.

checks.name: cheating_signal_caught
checks.description: a signal that reads the next bar's close must be stopped with 'signal uses future data'.

checks.name: trend_switch_passes
checks.description: the real trend switch, market ticker vs cash ticker, 200-day line, must pass the same guard on the training window and then run the backtester.
